n0725be7804.headline: Car expert: "Nasr E70" electric is a big step in local industry localization
n0725be7804.summary: The Ministry of Business Sector announced the Nasr E70 electric car, scheduled for production in mid-2022 by Nasr Automotive Company in Egypt.
n0725be7804.why: The launch of an electric vehicle by a local manufacturer marks a step toward industrial localization and EV adoption in Egypt.

n01c79b4d94.headline: Money from Customs Clearance of "Euro Plates" Will Go to Fight Coronavirus: Law Submitted to Rada
n01c79b4d94.summary: The Ukrainian Cabinet of Ministers submitted a law to allocate 1.4 billion hryvnias from customs clearance of euro plates to a fund for coronavirus response and vaccination.
n01c79b4d94.why: Government fiscal measures to fund health initiatives impact Ukraine's budget priorities and public health spending.
